title: Lean no_std feature set (units, simd, geometry)
body: The no_std path builds the whole crate minus linalg / systems / flux / gpu: 65 s for a wasm32 release build (rlib 14 MB). The node's intent asks for a lean feature set that compiles only units, simd and geometry, in seconds, for projects (parda-2d first) that want the small types without the DSP. Gate the other modules behind a default feature (or features per area) once Geometry and lanes / small types exists, and add it to the no-std CI job.
